title: Cisco CBS350 24-Port Gigabit Managed Network Switch with 4x 1G SFP Uplink

tabs.title: Description
tabs.html:
Cisco CBS350 24-Port Gigabit Managed Network Switch with 4x 1G SFP Uplink – High-Performance Network Solution for Business


The Cisco CBS350 24-Port Gigabit Managed Network Switch with 4x 1G SFP Uplink is an ideal choice for small to medium-sized businesses seeking a robust, reliable, and scalable networking solution. With 24 Gigabit Ethernet ports and 4 SFP uplink ports, this managed switch offers superior performance, seamless connectivity, and flexibility to support both wired and fiber-optic connections.


Key features include Power over Ethernet (PoE+) support, allowing you to power devices like IP phones, wireless access points, and IP cameras directly through the Ethernet cables, reducing the need for extra power adapters. VLAN support enables efficient network segmentation, while Quality of Service (QoS) ensures prioritized bandwidth for critical applications like voice and video.


This switch’s advanced security features, including MAC filtering, Access Control Lists (ACLs), and 802.1X authentication, protect your network from unauthorized access and ensure data integrity. Plus, with stacking capabilities, you can connect up to 4 Cisco CBS350 switches, creating a unified network management system for larger setups.


With easy management via the web-based GUI or CLI, the Cisco CBS350 24-Port Gigabit Managed Switch makes it simple to configure, monitor, and maintain your network. Its durable design, reliable performance, and energy-efficient operation make it a great choice for growing businesses looking to future-proof their network infrastructure.


Key Features:

  • 24 Gigabit Ethernet Ports and 4x 1G SFP uplink ports for flexible connectivity
  • PoE+ support to power devices like IP cameras and wireless access points
  • Layer 2 switching, VLAN support, and Advanced QoS for optimized network performance
  • Robust security with MAC filtering, ACLs, and 802.1X authentication
  • Stacking support for up to 4 switches for easy scalability
  • Web-based management and CLI access for easy configuration and monitoring
  • Energy-efficient design with reliable performance
  • Perfect for businesses needing a versatile, secure, and high-performance network solution, the Cisco CBS350 24-Port Managed Network Switch delivers the power, flexibility, and security you need to build a high-performing network.
